Market today:
Tech and chip names are facing a mixed bag. Earnings season is kicking off with chipmakers under the microscope, and AI chip stocks are wobbling. Meanwhile, Apple demand concerns are surfacing, but Microsoft is showing strength.

Your holdings:
SOXL (-37.82%) and SPAL (-22.17%) are your most pressing concerns. Both are leveraged ETFs, deep in the red, and flagged as 'SELL'. MUU (-9.3%) is also a leveraged ETF with a significant loss. Remember, trading on margin amplifies these drawdowns.

Watch:
Keep a close eye on upcoming chipmaker earnings and any further news regarding Apple's component orders. Also, monitor your leveraged positions closely for any stop breaches.

Bottom line:
Aggressively manage your high-risk, underperforming leveraged positions while awaiting clearer signals from the broader chip sector.
plays: Review and tighten stops on SOXL and SPAL immediately; their current stops are not protecting your capital on these deeply negative, leveraged positions.
Consider trimming SOXL and SPAL to reduce margin exposure and stem further losses on these decaying leveraged ETFs.
Watch SOXS for a potential hedge against your chip exposure, given the scanner setup (entry 34.36-34.32, stop 34.17) and recent chip sector wobbles.
